description:
Hyenas are among the most misunderstood animals on Earth. Often shown as cowardly scavengers, hyenas are actually highly intelligent, powerful, and socially complex predators.

In this video, we explore the types of hyenas found in the wild and uncover fascinating scientific facts about their behavior, intelligence, hunting skills, and role in nature.

🐾 What you’ll learn in this video:
• The 4 living species of hyenas
• Differences between spotted, striped, brown hyenas & aardwolf
• Why hyenas have one of the strongest bites in the animal kingdom
• The truth behind the famous “laughing” sound
• Female dominance and complex clan social structure
• How hyenas help maintain ecosystem balance

This video is based on scientifically accurate wildlife research and is perfect for animal lovers, students, and anyone curious about nature’s hidden truths.
